subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe map.setup to load library

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe map.setup to load library
parts:
Do this

suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))

sorry if this is a double post. Any ideas on this?

setup<-expression ({ 
  library(plyr)
  library(data.table)


})

plyr loads fine (on its own) and is usable in the map - data.table bombs out

I'm using R studio - R 2.15 on Ubuntu - on a single machine with 24 cores
